query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `vps_servers` (
  `id` INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `name` VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  `ip_address` VARCHAR(45) NOT NULL,
  `auth_token` VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  `is_active` BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE NOT NULL,
  `last_seen_at` TIMESTAMP NULL,
  `created_at` TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `vps_metrics` (
  `id` INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `server_id` INT NOT NULL,
  `cpu_percent` DECIMAL(5,2) NOT NULL,
  `memory_total` BIGINT NOT NULL,
  `memory_used` BIGINT NOT NULL,
  `memory_percent` DECIMAL(5,2) NOT NULL,
  `disk_total` BIGINT NOT NULL,
  `disk_used` BIGINT NOT NULL,
  `disk_percent` DECIMAL(5,2) NOT NULL,
  `network_sent` BIGINT NOT NULL,
  `network_recv` BIGINT NOT NULL,
  `load_average_1` DECIMAL(5,2),
  `load_average_5` DECIMAL(5,2),
  `load_average_15` DECIMAL(5,2),
  `timestamp` TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  FOREIGN KEY (`server_id`) REFERENCES `vps_servers`(`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  INDEX `idx_server_timestamp` (`server_id`, `timestamp`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `vps_alerts` (
  `id` INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `server_id` INT NOT NULL,
  `metric_type` ENUM('cpu', 'memory', 'disk', 'network') NOT NULL,
  `threshold` DECIMAL(5,2) NOT NULL,
  `is_active` BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE NOT NULL,
  `last_triggered_at` TIMESTAMP NULL,
  `created_at` TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  FOREIGN KEY (`server_id`) REFERENCES `vps_servers`(`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
);
